reason: I already have a site and my manager takes care of the small online things. Moving everything to a new system is a headache I don't have time for, and 25 euros a month for something that already works is not a priority.
objection: Switching from the site I already have means a new setup, maybe a lost address, and my manager learning yet another tool, all for something that isn't broken.
would_change_my_mind: If my manager tried it, said it really saves time on Google hours and the menu, and it could keep my existing site address with nothing to move.
